# NovaFox

The NovaFox studio page at **https://novafox.fr**: cozy games and handy apps that run in the browser.

DNS at IONOS: four A records on `@` to GitHub Pages (185.199.108.153 to .111), CNAME `www` to `lukalaurent.github.io`, CNAME `buzzworks` and CNAME `planizo` to `lukalaurent.github.io`. Custom domain and HTTPS are set in the repository Pages settings.

The page lives in [`site/`](../site) and is published to GitHub Pages on every push to `main`. `site/ads.txt` authorizes Google AdSense for the domain.

Projects: [Buzzworks](https://buzzworks.novafox.fr), [Planizo](https://planizo.novafox.fr), [MouseFence](https://github.com/LukaLaurent/MouseFence), [ScreenCycle](https://github.com/LukaLaurent/ScreenCycle), [WiseKiosk](https://lukalaurent.github.io/WiseKiosk/), [TaskWeb](https://github.com/LukaLaurent/TaskWeb).
